questions.q:
How many numbers which are smaller than 945 but greater than 360 are neither divisible by 4 nor by 9?

945 से छोटी लेकिन 360 से बड़ी कितनी संख्याएँ न तो 4 से विभाज्य हैं और न ही 9 से?
questions.s:
Numbers which are not divisible by both 4 and 9 = numbers not divisible by 4 + numbers not divisible by 9 - numbers not divisible by LCM of 4 and 9

LCM of 4 and 9 = 36

Now, total numbers between 360 and 945 = 584

We find the numbers among these 584 numbers which are divisible by 4, 9 and 36.

Numbers divisible by 4 = 364, 368 .., 944, i.e., there are 146 numbers.

Numbers divisible by 9 = 369, 378 .., 936, i.e., there are 64 numbers.

Numbers divisible by 36 = 396, 432, .., 936, i.e., there are 16 numbers.

So, numbers divisible by both 4 and 9 = 146 + 64 - 16 = 194

Hence, numbers not divisible by both 4 and 9 = 584 - 194 = 390 numbers

2. If the number 6523678pq is divisible by 99, the missing digits p and q are:

SSC GD 2021 17/11/2021 ( Evening )

99 = 11 × 9

For 6523678pq to be divisible by 9,

the sum of digits i.e. 6+5+2+3+6+7+8+p+q = 37+p+q,

must be divisible by 9. For this, p + q = 8 and 17

For 6523678pq to be divisible by 11,

the difference of the sum of its alternate digits i.e.

(q+8+6+2+6)- (p+7+3+5) = 22+q-15-p = 7+q-p,

must be divisible by 11. For this , q-p = -7 or 4 .

The only combinations which give p and q as single digits are p+q = 8 and q-p = 4

which gives p = 2 and q = 6.

Numbers which are not divisible by both 4 and 9 = numbers not divisible by 4 + numbers not divisible by 9 - numbers not divisible by LCM of 4 and 9

LCM of 4 and 9 = 36

Now, total numbers between 360 and 945 = 584

We find the numbers among these 584 numbers which are divisible by 4, 9 and 36.

Numbers divisible by 4 = 364, 368 .., 944, i.e., there are 146 numbers.

Numbers divisible by 9 = 369, 378 .., 936, i.e., there are 64 numbers.

Numbers divisible by 36 = 396, 432, .., 936, i.e., there are 16 numbers.

So, numbers divisible by both 4 and 9 = 146 + 64 - 16 = 194

Hence, numbers not divisible by both 4 and 9 = 584 - 194 = 390 numbers

questions_hin.q_hi:
2.यदि संख्या 6523678pq को 99 से विभाजित किया जा सकता है, तो अनुपस्थित अंक p और q का मान ज्ञात करें।

SSC GD 2021 17/11/2021 ( Evening )
questions_hin.s_hi:
2.(c)

99 = 11 × 9

6523678pq को 9 से विभाज्य होने के लिए,

अंकों का योग अर्थात 6 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 6 + 7 + 8 + p + q = 37 + p + q, 9 से विभाजित होना चाहिए।

इसके लिए, p + q = 8 और 17

6523678pq के 11 से विभाज्य होने के लिए,

इसके वैकल्पिक अंकों के योग का अंतर अर्थात

(q+8+6+2+6)- (p + 7 + 3 + 5) = 22 + q – 15 – p = 7 + q – p, 11 से विभाजित होना चाहिए।

इसके लिए, q-p = -7 या 4 केवल संयोजन जो p और q को एकल अंक के रूप में देते हैं,

वे हैं p + q = 8 और q – p = 4

जो p = 2 और q = 6 देता है।
